newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEP TO BE PART-FLOATED BY END-97 SAYS PREMIER.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEP TO BE PART-FLOATED BY END-97 SAYS PREMIER.

text.p: Greece's Development Ministry will proceed with the part-flotation of a maximum 10 percent stake in the state Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) on the Athens bourse by end-97, Prime Minister Costas Simitis told reporters.
DEP recently invited bids for a financial advisor that would help it in its part-flotation project.
The government wants to privatize all companies belonging to the Organisation for the Restructuring of Companies (OAE) in 1998, said Simitis.

He noted progress made by ETVA Bank in cutting operational costs by 1.0 billion drachmas as an example of what efficient management can do. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
